exams.name: Written Jurisprudence Examination
exams.quote: An applicant for licensure shall pass the written jurisprudence examination conducted by the board. A passing score of seventy-five percent (75%) correct shall be required on the written jurisprudence examination.

exams.name: National Board Dental Examinations
exams.notes: In lieu of written examinations other than the jurisprudence examination, the board may require and accept results of the national board dental examinations administered by the American Dental Association.
exams.quote: In lieu of conducting written examinations other than the jurisprudence examination, the board may require and accept the results of the national board dental and dental hygiene examinations administered by the American dental association.

exams.name: Clinical Examination
exams.notes: In lieu of conducting clinical examinations, the board may require and accept results of clinical examinations administered by national or regional testing organizations approved by the board.
exams.jurisdiction: national or regional testing organizations approved by the board
exams.quote: In lieu of conducting clinical examinations, the board may require and accept the results of clinical examinations administered by national or regional testing organizations approved by the board.

interval_years.quote: Each person determined by the board as qualified for licensure under this chapter shall pay the prescribed biennial license fee to the board prior to issuance of a license.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Four hundred dollars ($400) for a dentist with an active status

required.quote: Renewal of a license with active status requires compliance with requirements specified in rule.

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice dentistry without further examination upon evidence that: (1) The applicant currently holds an active license in good standing to practice dentistry in another state

requirements.value: Active license in good standing in another state; at least 5 years and 3,500 hours of clinical practice; graduated from CODA-accredited dental school; passed national board dental examinations; passed board-approved clinical examination; paid application fee.
requirements.quote: The applicant currently holds an active license in good standing to practice dentistry in another state with no disciplinary proceedings or unresolved complaints pending before the state's licensing board; The applicant has been in clinical practice at least five (5) years immediately preceding the date of application for a minimum of three thousand five hundred (3,500) hours

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally misstate or fail to disclose material facts in a licensure application, or procure a license by false or fraudulent means.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally misstate or fail fully to disclose a fact material to determination of fitness and qualification in an application for licensure to practice dentistry or cheat in an examination to practice dentistry; or procure a certificate or finding of qualification to practice dentistry or subsequently a license by false, fraudulent or deceitful means

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice dentistry under any name other than the dentist's own true name.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice dentistry under any name other than his own true name except as a professional service corporation or professional limited liability company

disciplinary_grounds.description: Make fraudulent, false, or misleading statements about skill or method of practice; claim to practice without pain; claim superiority; or publish evidence of cures.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Make, or cause to be made, or assist in making, any fraudulent, false, or misleading statement as to his own or an employee's, associate's, or other dentist's, dental therapist's, or dental hygienist's skill or lack of skill, or method of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use intoxicants or drugs to such a degree as to render the dentist unfit to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use intoxicants or drugs to such a degree as to render him unfit to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Provide dental care that fails to meet the standard of dental care provided by other qualified dentists in the same or similar communities.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commit malpractice, that is, to provide dental care that fails to meet the standard of dental care provided by other qualified dentists in the same community or similar communities, taking into account his training, experience and the degree of expertise to which he holds himself out to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engage in unprofessional conduct as defined by board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engage in unprofessional conduct, as defined by board rules

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertise in a way that deceives or defrauds, or probably deceives or defrauds, the public or patrons.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertise in such way as to deceive or defraud, or probably deceive or defraud, the public or patrons

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employ or permit an unlicensed person to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene in the dentist's office or under the dentist's control.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employ or permit any person not a dentist to practice dentistry, or any person not a dentist or dental therapist to practice dental therapy, or any person not a dentist or dental hygienist to practice dental hygiene, in his office or under his control or direction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fail, neglect, or refuse to keep office or equipment in accordance with current state and federal laws, rules, and regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fail, neglect or refuse to keep his office or equipment, or otherwise conduct his work, in accordance with current state and federal laws, rules and regulations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violate any other provisions of law or rules adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violate any other provisions of law or rules adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely identify oneself to the public as a specialist in a specialty area of dentistry as defined by rule.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsely identify himself to the public as a specialist in a specialty area of dentistry as defined by rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engage in the practice of dentistry as a member, stockholder, employee, director, partner, or proprietor in any business entity in which a non-licensed person holds an ownership interest.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engage in the practice of dentistry as a member, stockholder, employee, director, partner or proprietor in any business entity in which a person, not duly licensed to practice dentistry in this state, holds an ownership interest.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Supervise more than three dental therapists.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Supervise more than three (3) dental therapists

disciplinary_grounds.description: Require a patient to sign an agreement limiting the patient's right or ability to file a complaint with the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Require directly, or as a member, representative, contracted agent, or employee of or in connection with any company, association, corporation, or partnership, that a patient sign an agreement limiting his right or ability to file a complaint with the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a relevant crime, including felony conviction requiring notification to the board within 30 days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A certificate or other evidence of qualification and right to practice dentistry ... may be revoked by the board whenever it shall be shown to the board that the holder ... has been convicted of a crime that is deemed relevant in accordance with section 67-9411(1), Idaho Code

establishment_regulation_required.quote: To inspect or cause to be inspected the offices or operating rooms of all persons licensed under this chapter.

definition_quote.value: The practice of dentistry is the doing by one (1) person, for a direct or indirect consideration, of one or more of the following with respect to the teeth, gums, alveolar process, jaws, or adjacent tissues of another person, namely: Examining for diagnosis, treatment, extraction, repair, replacement, substitution, or correction; Diagnosing of disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity or physical condition; Treating, operating, prescribing, extracting, repairing, taking impressions, fitting, replacing, substituting, or correcting; Administering anesthetics or medicaments in connection with any of the foregoing.

specialist_license_available.quote: "Dental specialist" is a dentist who has graduated from a board-approved postgraduate program in the dentist's specialty and is a person both qualified and licensed by the laws of Idaho to practice a dental specialty recognized by the board.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" is supervision of a dental therapist, dental assistant, or dental hygienist requiring that a dentist diagnose the condition to be treated, that a dentist authorize the procedure to be performed, that a dentist remain in the practice setting while the procedure is performed... "General supervision" is supervision of a dental therapist, dental assistant, or dental hygienist requiring that a dentist authorize the procedure which is carried out, but not requiring that a dentist be in the practice setting... "Indirect supervision" is supervision of a dental therapist, dental assistant, or dental hygienist requiring that a dentist authorize a procedure and that a dentist be in the practice setting while the procedure is performed
